runs.scope_summary: elo-promotion feature cluster (10 commits: elo math module, archive pool enumeration, opponent inference plumbing, per-opponent ladder eval task, env-var wiring, candidate_elo baseline scoring, plus fmt/doc/wiki/log commits)

findings.status: CONFIRMED (adversarial second-pass verified all load-bearing details)
findings.title: Elo ladder cannot activate after first promotion — pool excludes just-promoted champion and bootstrap fallback matches challenger against itself
findings.failure_scenario: Fresh baseline run cleans best_v*.pt. Cycle 1: pool empty, bootstrap path plays challenger vs. frozen best.pt (resume checkpoint), challenger wins, promote() writes best_v{V1}.pt and stores challenger_evaluator.clone() as champion. Cycle 2+: pool = {V1} \ {exclude=V1} = empty; bootstrap uses champion_store.champion() which is the challenger's own evaluator handle routed through the same inference_tx channel → challenger-vs-itself on live training weights → win_rate ≈ 0.5, rarely crosses promotion_threshold=0.55. Log signature: PROMOTIONS=1 with LAST_CANDIDATE_ELO=1500.0 for many cycles, 'pool_size=0 opponents=none' in every [eval] ladder_match line despite best_v*.pt archives existing on disk. Ladder self-heals only after a second lucky bootstrap promotion.
findings.dead_code_note: src/bin/selfplay.rs:521-529 wires a SwappableBackend champion_backend, but self.champion_backend (set at evaluation.rs:148) is never read anywhere; the _swappable binding is dropped immediately in the non-resume branch (bin/selfplay.rs:359).
minimal_fixes: (a) Pass sentinel 0 (or None) instead of champion_version at src/selfplay/evaluation.rs:249 so the just-promoted archive stays in the pool. Opponent server reloads weights per pool member (with_opponent's load_weights loop), so serving the same version the challenger is compared to is fine (snapshot vs. live-evolving challenger).

(b) Wire champion_backend for real: on promote, swap it to a fresh PyO3Backend loaded from the checkpoint src so champion_store.champion() routes through an independent inference server whose weights lag the challenger.
findings.open_design_question: Should the pool be 'past champions including current-snapshot' (fix a) or 'strictly older past champions with independent inference server' (fix b)? Author decision required.
